approach: Initial background plates used as inputs for the final integrated product photographs. See hero-integrated-campaigns.json for final image prompts. No Farmley artwork copied.

prompts.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create one exceptionally natural photographic background plate for a premium Indian roasted makhana ecommerce campaign. Landscape 2400 x 1100, wide 24:11 composition. This is an actual commercial food-stylist photograph shot on a full-frame camera, not a 3D illustration. Warm golden ochre plaster wall and honey-coloured stone tabletop, sun from upper left, credible soft leaf shadows high on the wall, subtle grain and imperfections. LEFT 45 percent is completely clean softly lit ochre negative space for large real HTML headline, no objects, no writing. RIGHT half: a low, empty rectangular warm sandstone riser at x=70%, its top surface visible and large enough to stand one snack pouch, leave the entire upright area above this riser EMPTY. In front of the riser near lower right, a low handmade cream ceramic bowl with irregular real puffed fox nuts lightly coated in orange-red Indian masala; a few scattered puffs with porous toasted surfaces, half a real lime, one red chilli and three coriander leaves on the tabletop. Food looks edible, seasonings vary naturally, real restrained shadows, shot 65mm with moderate depth of field. All meaningful food and riser fit in the rightmost half and centre vertical 65 percent so banner crops naturally. No packets, no bags, no packaging, no text, no logos, no people, no watermarks, no floating objects, no exaggerated spice clouds, no glowing rim light, no glossy plastic CGI food, no over-symmetry. Realistic natural colour, tactile and professionally art-directed. The finished webpage will layer an original product pack on the EMPTY riser and live type in the EMPTY left, so preserve both spaces.

Use case: ads-marketing. Create one exceptionally natural commercial food photography background for a premium Indian Cream and Onion roasted makhana web campaign. Wide landscape 2400 x 1100, 24:11. Camera 65mm lens, real editorial still life, tactile objects and natural imperfections, appetising restraint. Pale warm sage painted plaster wall and light almond-coloured limestone tabletop, soft daylight from upper left, a faint natural window shadow on upper wall. LEFT 45 percent is clear sage negative space with no objects, no writing, suitable for large dark headline. In RIGHT half put a low empty rectangular cream travertine riser at x=70%, its top plane visible, with a clean EMPTY upright region above it for a product pouch that will be added separately. Around the lower right foreground, a shallow handmade ivory bowl of real puffed fox nuts with light toasted patches and tiny flecks of dried onion and herbs, one small halved red onion exposing crisp rings, a little folded natural linen and two short chive stems. A few casually scattered puffed fox nuts have uneven porous shapes. Believable shadows, soft microtexture, natural food styling rather than impossible floating arrangements. Keep the meaningful props in the right half and central vertical 65 percent for a wide banner crop. No pouches, bags, packaging, text, symbols, logos, people, watermark, artificial bokeh balls, idealised smooth spheres, hyper-saturated greens, CGI sheen or illustration. Looks like a real carefully lit food studio photograph. Preserve EMPTY space above riser and the EMPTY left for actual product artwork and live website copy.

Use case: ads-marketing. Produce a high-end, convincingly REAL food studio photograph as a background plate for Peri Peri roasted makhana website banner. Landscape 2400 x 1100, wide 24:11. Deep warm paprika-red matte plaster background, muted terracotta stone tabletop, beautiful directional natural afternoon light from upper left, believable shadows, authentic surface grain. LEFT 45 percent completely clear red negative space, no props or writing; this area will carry pale headline text in HTML. RIGHT half contains a short empty rectangular red clay or terracotta pedestal at x=70%, with its top visible and EMPTY space above it reserved for a real snack pouch image. In the foreground right, a low cream speckled ceramic bowl of naturally irregular porous puffed fox nuts with rust-red peri peri seasoning, a pair of real red chillies, a small half lime with realistic juicy pulp, restrained flakes of paprika and five casually scattered makhana. Visceral appetising food textures, uneven hand-applied seasoning, shot with 65mm lens by a commercial food photographer, moderate depth of field and no excessive processing. Keep product stage and food within the right half and middle vertical 65 percent so a wide crop works. No bags, packets or packaging, no text or logos, no people, no watermarks, no flames, no floating ingredients, no smoke, no glossy plastic sphere snacks, no CGI style, no cartoon or dramatic black gradients. The intended webpage layers an original pack on the EMPTY stage and live type on the left, so preserve those spaces.

Use case: ads-marketing. Create a premium natural commercial food photograph background plate for Himalayan Pink Salt roasted makhana ecommerce hero. Landscape 2400 x 1100, wide 24:11. Warm pale blush and off-white plaster wall, ivory limestone tabletop with delicate real grain, soft morning daylight from upper left, a quiet genuine window shadow. LEFT 45 percent is uncluttered pale blush negative space for a large dark editable headline, with no food or objects or text. RIGHT half: low empty rectangular pale pink sandstone riser around x=70% with its top plane visible, leave the entire vertical space above riser EMPTY so a real product pouch will be layered in later. In foreground right a shallow ivory ceramic bowl filled with real unsauced puffed fox nuts, slightly toasted, irregular porous surfaces and just a few pink salt grains. Nearby a small rough chunk of Himalayan pink salt and a tiny understated wooden pinch spoon containing a few salt crystals; four naturally scattered makhana. No over-arrangement or pristine CGI perfection. Real colour variation, gentle tactile texture, credible contact shadows, shot with a 65mm lens, bright sophisticated Indian food campaign, natural rather than generated appearance. Keep food and riser in the right half and central 65 percent of height for responsive cropping. No packets, pouches, packaging, text, logos, watermark, people, flowers, pink clouds, floating crystals, fairy lighting, CGI or artificial glossy food. Maintain EMPTY riser and EMPTY left copy space for actual packaging and live type.
